name: miningdataapi
description: Mining Data API: drill results, financings, financial statements, projects, technical reports and spin-outs extracted from public filings of listed mining companies. Read-only; sign in with your Mining Data API account.

interface.longDescription:
Mining Data API gives ChatGPT read-only access to structured facts extracted from the public filings of listed mining companies: drill results, financings, financial statements, projects, technical reports and spin-outs. Ask for the strongest recent drill intercepts, a briefing on a ticker, every placement above a price, or project economics such as NPV and IRR. Every answer can cite the disclosure it came from.

All tools are read-only. You sign in with your existing Mining Data API account.
defaultPrompt: Show me the best gold drill intercepts released in the last 30 days.
Build a briefing on FM.TO: flagship project, drilling, financings and cash runway.
Find and analyze standout copper drill results and explain the screening criteria.

positive.description: Screen recent drill intercepts for a commodity
positive.prompt: Show me the best gold drill intercepts released in the last 30 days.
positive.expected_behavior: Resolves gold to the commodity code, searches drill results released in the last 30 days sorted by drill score, and lists hole id, interval, length and grade per result with the record id and company for each row.

positive.prompt: Build a briefing on FM.TO: flagship project, drilling, financings and cash runway.
positive.expected_behavior: Looks up the ticker to a company id, fetches the company dossier and summarises the flagship project, recent drilling, financings and the latest cash position, citing record ids and stating when a field is not available.

positive.description: Guided screening of standout drill results for a commodity
positive.prompt: Use the connected Mining Data API to help me find and analyze standout drill results. Commodity focus: Copper. Explain the screening criteria, use the API's available data, and clearly state limitations.
positive.expected_behavior: Explains the screening criteria it will apply, resolves copper to the commodity code, searches drill results sorted by drill score, opens the top records for their intervals, and states what the dataset does not cover.

positive.prompt: List copper company financings above 20 million dollars announced this year.
positive.expected_behavior: Searches financings filtered by primary commodity copper, gross proceeds above 20 million and an announcement date in the current year, and reports instrument, gross proceeds, price per unit and the issuing company with record ids.

positive.description: Plan and usage check works on every plan
positive.prompt: How much of my Mining Data API quota have I used this month?
positive.expected_behavior: Calls get_usage and reports the current plan, the datasets it includes and the rows and requests consumed against the plan limits, without calling any data tool.

negative.description: General knowledge question unrelated to mining data
negative.prompt: What is the capital of Australia?

negative.description: Request to place a trade, which the plugin cannot and must not do
negative.prompt: Buy 500 shares of Rio Tinto for me right now.

negative.description: Creative writing that mentions a metal but needs no data
negative.prompt: Write a short poem about a gold sunset.

review.commerce_description: No commerce. The plugin is read-only and never sells, starts a subscription or links to a checkout. Data tools require an existing paid Mining Data API plan; the only link it ever shows is the public pricing page for plan information.

publication.release_notes: First public directory release of Mining Data API for ChatGPT. Read-only access to drill results, financings, financial statements, projects, technical reports and spin-outs over OAuth. 1.2.1 clears the listing text of plan wording.
